::: {.content-visible when-format="docx"}
# Book_07 — Access Control: Groups, Roles, and the Entra Perimeter
:::

::: {.callout-note}
The migration changes the identity authority for SQL Server's groups from Active Directory to Entra ID, but it does not eliminate group-based access control — it transforms the group lifecycle. Where an AD group required a helpdesk ticket, an OrgPath-driven dynamic Entra group updates itself as HR data changes. The governance dividend is Conditional Access as the outer perimeter. (ADR-036, ADR-067, ADR-037)
:::
